senses.gloss:
ITA-5.74.13 dadhi-mithyopayogaḥ दधि-मिथ्योपयोगः
Disorder due to improper consumption of curd
A person consuming curd inappropriately; deviating from the prescribed rules.

ITA-8.2.24 dadhikūrcikā दधिकूर्चिका
Solid part of milk boiled with curd
The solid portion obtained when milk is boiled with curd.

ITA-8.2.27 dadhimastu दधिमस्तु
Watery part of curd
The supernatant liquid portion of curd.

ITA-8.2.16 dadhivargaḥ दधिवर्गः
Group of curds
Curds, and the stages of their preparation, from the milk of various animals.
